card.name: Small words before listed or classified status
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, the, as, for, an opening parenthesis) right before a status, classification or cross-reference, such as threatened species, Schedule II, Red List, or see Warnings sections.

modes.label: Status or schedule label
modes.description: The word a or the comes just before a conservation or drug-control classification.
modes.example: Classified as Least Concern (LC) on<< the>> IUCN Red List (1).

modes.label: Dose-modification wording
modes.description: A small word follows withhold [drug] in standard immune-reaction dosing text, before severity grades.
modes.example: In general, withhold IMFINZI<< for>> severe (Grade 3) immune-mediated

modes.label: Listed as
modes.description: The word as follows listed, before a status category.
modes.example: flow-dependent plant species listed<< as>> vulnerable in Victoria

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like covered, listed and outlined, which refer to a section or listing.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a category, status or section reference is named.
